Sauce & Condiment

Anchovy Paste

About This Entry

Anchovy paste delivers deep, salty umami without the whole fillets, dissolving invisibly into Caesar dressing, pasta sauces, and braises — that savory depth pairs with the dark fruit of Malbec.
